name: application-effort-estimate-chips
title: Effort Estimate Chips
description: Single-select chip group for story points or t-shirt sizes, rendered as a real radiogroup — pass any Fibonacci or size scale via the options prop.
useWhen: Estimating task effort with a Fibonacci story-point scale (1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13) or t-shirt sizes (XS–XL).
You want a compact single-select control instead of a full select dropdown for a short scale.
A "?" or "unsure" option should be part of the same scale as the numeric values.
avoidWhen: Multiple values need to be selectable at once — use tag-filter-group instead.
The scale has many options (10+) — a select or combobox scales better than a chip row.
You need free-text estimates — use a plain number input instead.
responsiveBehavior: Chips wrap onto multiple lines within a flex-wrap row as the container narrows.
accessibility: The group is a real fieldset/legend with role='radiogroup' and each chip as role='radio' with aria-checked.
The selected chip is marked by both a filled background and a colored border, not color alone.
Chips are real buttons, reachable and operable via keyboard tab and Enter/Space.

variants.title: Effort estimate chips
variants.description: Fibonacci story-point scale (1/2/3/5/8/13/?) with 5 selected, on a light surface.
accessibility: The default options array covers the standard Fibonacci scale plus a "?" unsure option.

variants.title: Effort estimate chips (Dark)
variants.description: The same Fibonacci story-point scale with 5 selected, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Chip border, fill, and text colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
